REPL Commands:
  .help (.h)         Show every command, alias, and published keybinding
  .exit (.quit, .q)  End the session through orderly shutdown
  .clear (.cls)      Clear an interactive display without resetting session state
  .load <path>       Read a virtual path through typed authority and evaluate its supported contents
  .time <input>      Evaluate input with prompt semantics and report elapsed time
  .break             Abandon a pending multiline continuation
  .mounts            Show the virtual mount table and virtual current directory

Keybindings:
  Tab     Complete without authorizing effects or evaluating user code
  Ctrl+C  Cancel, discard, or escalate according to session state
  Ctrl+D  Exit at an empty prompt; otherwise delete forward
  Ctrl+R  Search session history in reverse
  Ctrl+Z  Restore the terminal, suspend, and recapture on resume
